description: This file defines the 'Coocook::Model::Ingredients' class, which encapsulates business logic for handling ingredient data structures related to dishes and recipes in the Coocook project. It manages attributes such as articles, units, ingredients, project, and servings, and provides methods for constructing ingredient data arrays and editing ingredient details.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Ingredients
classes.description: A class providing business logic for handling ingredients data structures, including attributes for articles, units, ingredients, project, and servings, as well as methods for constructing ingredient arrays and editing.

methods.name: build_project
methods.description: Constructs and returns the associated project object based on the ingredients.

methods.name: as_arrayref
methods.description: Generates an array reference of ingredient data hashes, scaled to the specified number of servings.

methods.name: for_ingredients_editor
methods.description: Prepares ingredient data for editing, including available unit conversions.
